raw.query: WITH cells AS (SELECT resolution, variate, MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE model IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto')) AS best_fm_wape, MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE model IN ('naive','ewma','holt_winters')) AS best_baseline_wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE span='common' AND h=-1 AND candidate='point' GROUP BY resolution, variate) SELECT COUNT(*) AS cells, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE best_fm_wape < best_baseline_wape) AS fm_wins FROM cells;
raw.claimed: the foundation models beat every baseline in all twenty cells
raw.evidence: Best foundation-model point WAPE is lower than the best baseline WAPE in all 20 common-span resolution-signal cells.
